label: Secrets in the Git history (Gitleaks)
description: Scans the whole Git history for secrets with gitleaks git (redacted report). Comes in by evidence: only when the workspace is a Git repository (.git/HEAD); runs only where secrets-history is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Runs in the security-scanners image that jgates tools prepare pins; without it the check is reported as not available here, never passed.
